dedupeText: urban monochromatic hip hop portrait puffer jacket brushed metal fisheye perspective urban fashion beveled type monochrome palette subject to surface interaction where hands rest on a metallic foreground contrast between soft quilted textile and hard cold metal perspective distortion emphasizing the foreground text and the scale of the jackets combine urban fashion photography with industrial 3d typography on a brushed metal surface using a low angle fisheye perspective and high key monochromatic lighting

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-angle portrait of two men in oversized white puffer jackets leaning over a reflective brushed metal surface, featuring heavy, industrial 3D typography embossed into the foreground plane.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-surface interaction where hands rest on a metallic foreground
Contrast between soft, quilted textile and hard, cold metal
Perspective distortion emphasizing the foreground text and the scale of the jackets
coreInvariants: Brushed steel or aluminum foreground texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the upper half of the frame, leaning forward; the foreground metal surface dominates the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, beveled 3D text centered in the lower third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subjects' faces, follows their arms down to their clasped hands, and rests on the large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white studio background provides high contrast for the white jackets.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light gray (jackets and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark skin tones for definition
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver/steel with subtle warm reflections
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation; focus is on value contrast and texture rather than hue.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif or blocky industrial sans
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with deep 3D beveling
Inner decorative detailing resembling industrial rivets or plating
Stacked layout with varying widths per line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letter 'S' replaced or modified with a dollar sign motif
Letter 'I' featuring a cross-bar or currency-inspired vertical strike
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face used in multiple sizes to create a block-like visual mass.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for 3D treatment.
The original is highly customized with internal details and currency motifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle studio photograph of two men in oversized white puffer jackets leaning over a large, flat sheet of brushed steel. The background is pure white. The lighting is bright and even, creating soft shadows in the jacket folds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a three-line stack of heavy, beveled 3D block text onto the metal surface in the foreground. The text should appear embossed into the metal, following the perspective of the surface, with a metallic texture and industrial detailing.

verificationChecks: Is the text perspective-aligned to the metal surface?
Do the jackets appear voluminous and quilted?
Is the color palette strictly neutral/metallic?
Is the lighting high-key with deep contrast in the folds?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any brand logos on headbands or clothing
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sense of heavy physical weight in the typography

postGenerationChecks: Verify the text looks like it is physically part of the metal table.
Ensure the white jackets do not blow out into the white background completely.
Check that the perspective distortion feels intentional and consistent.
Confirm no protected logos are visible on the clothing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Fashion Photography] with [Industrial 3D Typography] on a [Brushed Metal Surface] using a [Low-Angle Fisheye Perspective] and [High-Key Monochromatic Lighting].
